claims.claim: Pär Nyman was dismasted late on November 22 in the Golden Globe Race.
claims.episode_span: Swedish skipper Pär Nyman was dismasted late on November 22 in the Golden Globe Race and is now jury-rigging toward port.
claims.source_title: Golden Globe: Dismasted in Indian Ocean
claims.supporting_quote: Swedish skipper Pär Nyman, sailing the Rustler 36 Lazy Otter, was dismasted in heavy weather late on November 22, approximately 1,000 nautical miles southeast of Cape Town, South Africa.

claims.claim: The Ocean Race announced Porto as its new operational headquarters and Atlantic base from 2028 through 2040.
claims.episode_span: The Ocean Race announced a long-term partnership that moves its operational headquarters and Atlantic base to Porto, Portugal, from 2028 through 2040.
claims.source_title: The Ocean Race and Porto celebrate a new Atlantic base for Ocean Racing
claims.supporting_quote: The Ocean Race has announced a significant long-term partnership with Portugal, designating Porto as the new operational home of the race from 2028 through 2040.

claims.claim: Banque Populaire XI has been righted in the Azores and is under tow 1,300 nautical miles to Lorient.
claims.episode_span: The 105-foot Ultim trimaran Banque Populaire XI, which capsized in the mid-Atlantic during the Route du Rhum, has been righted in the Azores and is now under tow for the 1,300-nautical-mile return to its base in Lorient.
claims.source_title: Ultim Banque Populaire XI righted in the Azores. Now on 1300nm tow to Lorient
claims.supporting_quote: Ultim Banque Populaire XI righted in the Azores. Now on 1300nm tow to Lorient

claims.claim: As of 23 November 2026 the team's YB tracker shows EMIRA IV at 50.47°N, 1.28°W.
claims.episode_span: As of 23 November 2026 the team's YB tracker shows EMIRA IV at 50.47°N, 1.28°W.
claims.supporting_quote: As of 23 November 2026, the team's YB tracker has EMIRA IV at 50.47°N, 1.28°W.

claims.claim: Scott Shawyer and Alan Roberts will sail the RORC Transatlantic Race double-handed on EMIRA IV starting 10 January 2027.
claims.episode_span: On 21 November Canada Ocean Racing posted that Scott Shawyer and Alan Roberts will sail the foiling IMOCA double-handed in the RORC Transatlantic Race starting 10 January 2027 from Lanzarote to Antigua.
claims.source_title: Counting down to the RORC Transatlantic: what will be different this time?
claims.supporting_quote: On 10 January 2027, Scott and Alan will take on one of offshore sailings great challenges: racing across the Atlantic Ocean non-stop aboard the foiling IMOCA, Emira IV.
